prompt: Find 100 new funders (VCs, Angel groups, Grant providers). For each funder, you MUST: 1) Verify they are NOT already listed in ANY existing file within the '01_equity/' directory. 2) Validate their official website. 3) Populate all fields: 'Organization', 'Contact Person', 'LinkedIn', 'Phone', 'Website', 'Country', 'Territory', 'Industry', 'Funder Type', 'Funding Type', 'Source / Verification', 'Notes', 'Status', and 'Last Verified'. RULES: a) NO PLACEHOLDERS: Never generate generic 'contact@domain.com' or 'info@domain.com' unless explicitly verified. b) CITATION REQUIRED: The 'Source / Verification' column MUST contain a direct URL to the page where contact info was found (e.g., 'Contact Us' or 'Team' page). c) BLANK OVER GUESSED: If an email is not found, leave it blank or provide a LinkedIn URL of an investment partner. d) ONE FILE PER FUNDER: Each new funder must be saved as a separate .md file in '01_equity/' using the organization name as the filename (e.g., 'sequoia_capital.md'). Use '01_equity/template.md' as the format. e) STEWARDSHIP: Update '01_equity/registry_audit_log.md' with new counts. **ISOLATION**: Explicitly IGNORE the 'published/' directory. Focus: AI, Tech, Fintech, Emerging Markets, Military.
title: Mission: 100 Funder Research (Verified & Cited)
